prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on the 2018 underwriting year as shown in the gross claims development table (increase in the 2018 cumulative gross claims estimate).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at 1 January 2020 were GBP 1.645m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows adverse prior-year development on the 2018 underwriting year of approximately GBP 1.259m (strengthening of reserves), representing ~76.6% of the opening reserve. The financial year result was also impacted by COVID-19 exposures in the contingency book and by large loss/property and casualty development.
raw_causal_phrases: The loss for the financial year is mainly attributable to the SPA's exposure to losses arising from Covid19 within the contingency book of business.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (GBP 1.259m) was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative gross claims by underwriting year). No explicit verbal statement quantifying the gross prior-year reserve movement was found. The calculation excludes 2019 and 2020 as required. Figures in the triangle are presented in GBP '000; conversion to millions has been applied. Exact reserve movement text not present in the report.
